title: Mendoza vows ‘merit-based employee empowerment’ at BOC
summary: MANILA, Philippines — “Merit-based employee empowerment” at the Bureau of Customs should go hand in hand with stronger revenue collection and intensified anti-smuggling operations, Customs…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — “Merit-based employee empowerment” at the Bureau of Customs should go hand in hand with stronger revenue collection and intensified anti-smuggling operations, Customs Commissioner Charlito Martin R. Mendoza stressed during his first flag-raising ceremony at the BOC central office in Manila on Monday. “Warfare should always go hand in hand with the welfare of our employees,” Mendoza said.
